market_reason: Tech/AI selloff (Nasdaq-100 near bear market, S&P down ~3% earlier), new tariff proposals, a hawkish Fed poised to hike, and fresh Gulf attacks lifting oil. These are elevated but largely priced, and US markets are closed for Thanksgiving.

AI rout drags Wall Street lower, S&P 500 slumps 3% - Anchorage Daily News
Hawkish Fed poised to raise rates despite stock market turmoil - Financial Times
summary: Risk is elevated from the AI-driven equity slide, new Trump tariff proposals and a hawkish Fed, which matter for the 25% SSO position. Renewed Middle East and Strait of Hormuz attacks are lifting crude to a 3-week high, which mostly helps the small XLE, USO and DBC holdings and doesn't justify a veto.
